sections.text: Endless scrolling, and still nothing you both want to watch?
And the film you finally agree on isn't on your streaming service?
Meet Movie Match. One phone, two of you, one film tonight.
Tick the services you pay for, pick a mood each, and pass the phone.
Then react to a few films. It gets to know your taste as you play. No watch history needed.
Behind the scenes, it searches over fifteen thousand films for ones close to what you both liked.
Then AI ranks them for tonight's mood and your personal movie taste.
Only films on your subscriptions make the cut, so no more checking app after app.
You each pick the ones you'd watch.
Where your lists meet, that's your film, and where to watch it.
Movie Match. Try it with someone tonight.
